segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we're talking a little bit about, well, kind of girly things.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们在谈论一些少女的事情。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We've talked about guys' shoes, women's shoes.
segments.zh: 我们谈过男鞋，女鞋。

segments.en: So now we're going to talk about another aspect of women's accessories.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们要谈谈女性配饰的另一个方面。

segments.en: We're going to talk about makeup.
segments.zh: 我们要谈谈化妆。

segments.en: Okay, so we're wearing makeup today.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们今天化妆。

segments.en: Actually we're buying makeup at the store.
segments.zh: 其实我们在商店买化妆品。

segments.en: I never even knew there were so many kinds of makeup.
segments.zh: 我什至不知道有这么多的妆容。

segments.en: So we're going to learn all about these in today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以我们将在今天的对话中了解所有这些。

segments.en: I'm hungry.
segments.zh: 我饿了。

segments.en: Let's go grab a bite to eat.
segments.zh: 我们去吃点东西吧。

segments.en: Yeah, me too.
segments.zh: 对，我也是。

segments.en: Oh, can we stop at the shop really fast?
segments.zh: 哦，我们可以很快在商店停下来吗？

segments.en: I lost my makeup bag at the airport and I want to pick up a few things.
segments.zh: 我的化妆包丢在机场了，想补买几样东西。

segments.en: Will you take long?
segments.zh: 你要很久吗？

segments.en: No, five minutes.
segments.zh: 不会，就五分钟。

segments.en: I promise.
segments.zh: 我保证。

segments.en: Come on.
segments.zh: 来吧。

segments.en: We've been here for almost an hour.
segments.zh: 我们已经在这里待了将近一个小时。

segments.en: I thought you said you were only going to get a few things.
segments.zh: 你不是说只买几样东西吗？

segments.en: How long does it take you to pick out a lipstick and some nail polish?
segments.zh: 挑选口红和指甲油需要多长时间？

segments.en: Are you crazy?
segments.zh: 你疯了吗？

segments.en: You have no idea what you're talking about.
segments.zh: 你不知道你在说什么。

segments.en: Just for my eyes I have to get eyeliner, an eyelash curler, eye shadow, an eyebrow pencil, and mascara.
segments.zh: 光是眼妆用品，我就得买眼线笔、睫毛夹、眼影、眉笔和睫毛膏。

segments.en: Then I need to get foundation, liquid foundation.
segments.zh: 然后还得买粉底，液体粉底。

segments.en: Whoa, whoa, whoa.
segments.zh: 等等，等等，等等。

segments.en: Are you nuts?
segments.zh: 你疯了吗？

segments.en: How much is all this going to cost?
segments.zh: 这一切要花多少钱？

segments.en: I'm looking at the price of each one of these little things and it's outrageous.
segments.zh: 我在看这些小东西的价格，这太离谱了。

segments.en: This is basically a crayon.
segments.zh: 这基本上是蜡笔。

segments.en: What about you?
segments.zh: 你呢？

segments.en: You spend as much money or more on your razors, aftershave, cologne, and gel.
segments.zh: 你在剃须刀、须后水、古龙水和发胶上花的钱也不少，甚至比我更多。

segments.en: Not to mention how much you spend on clothes and...
segments.zh: 更不用说你在衣服上花了多少钱和...

segments.en: Fine.
segments.zh: 行吧。

segments.en: Get the stupid $30 crayon.
segments.zh: 买你那支三十美元的破“蜡笔”吧。

segments.en: Alright, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So obviously we're getting a lot of things for this girl, a lot of makeup.
segments.zh: 所以很明显，我们为这个女孩买了很多东西，很多化妆。

segments.en: So I think there are a couple of things that we may not know about.
segments.zh: 所以我认为有几件事我们可能不知道。

segments.en: So let's take a look at them now on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以让我们现在看看他们的语言外卖。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: So the first thing we're talking about today is a basic.
segments.zh: 所以我们今天谈论的第一件事是基本的。

segments.en: Most women carry this around in their purses.
segments.zh: 大多数女性在钱包里随身携带。

segments.en: It's called lipstick.
segments.zh: 它被称为口红。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And as you said, this is a pretty basic thing.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，这是一个非常基本的事情。

segments.en: It's the kind of like paint that you put on your lips.
segments.zh: 这是你放在嘴唇上的那种油漆。

segments.en: And it's called a lipstick because it looks like a little stick.
segments.zh: 它被称为口红，因为它看起来像一根小棍子。

segments.en: Right, and you turn it with your fingers and it comes up and then you turn it again and it goes down, basically keeping it from touching all of the things in your purse.
segments.zh: 是的，你用手指转动它，它会上升，然后你再次转动它，它会下降，基本上防止它接触到你钱包里的所有东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So lipstick.
segments.zh: 所以唇膏。

segments.en: And well, apart from this, we also have nail polish.
segments.zh: 好吧，除此之外，我们还有指甲油。

segments.en: And this is also very popular with the ladies when you paint your nails a certain color.
segments.zh: 当你把指甲涂成某种颜色时，这也很受女士们的欢迎。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So polish is basically anything that makes something shiny.
segments.zh: 所以抛光基本上是任何使某物闪亮的东西。

segments.en: It's something that you add to surfaces.
segments.zh: 这是您添加到表面的东西。

segments.en: So you could add polish to wood on a table.
segments.zh: 因此，您可以为桌子上的木材添加抛光剂。

segments.en: But in this case, we're putting it on our nails.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，我们会把它放在我们的指甲上。

segments.en: That is fingernails or toenails.
segments.zh: 那是指甲或脚趾甲。

segments.en: So it's nail polish.
segments.zh: 所以是指甲油。

segments.en: Alright, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And now we're getting into the specific things.
segments.zh: 现在我们正在进入特定的事情。

segments.en: A lot of makeup that women use on their eyes.
segments.zh: 很多女性在眼睛上使用的化妆品。

segments.en: So for example, the first thing she said, she needs to get an eyeliner.
segments.zh: 例如，她说的第一句话，她需要涂上眼线笔。

segments.en: Okay, so eyeliner is basically a pencil.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以眼线笔基本上是一支铅笔。

segments.en: This is what the guy is making fun of her about.
segments.zh: 这就是男人取笑她的原因。

segments.en: He says it's just a pencil or a crayon for your eye.
segments.zh: 他说这只是你的眼睛的铅笔或蜡笔。

segments.en: And so basically, you use it to draw a line on the top or the bottom of your eye, your eyelid.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，你用它在你的眼睛顶部或底部画一条线，你的眼睑。

segments.en: Okay, so yeah, it kind of looks like a marker and it comes, I think, black and different colors and then you paint little lines around your eyes to make them more pronounced.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以是的，它看起来像一个标记，它来了，我认为，黑色和不同的颜色，然后你在眼睛周围画出小线，使它们更明显。

segments.en: So it's called an eyeliner.
segments.zh: 所以它被称为眼线笔。

segments.en: Okay, and now we have an eyelash curler.
segments.zh: 好的，现在我们有一个睫毛夹。

segments.en: And also, I think this is very important for the ladies.
segments.zh: 而且，我认为这对女士们来说非常重要。

segments.en: Yeah, well not everyone uses this.
segments.zh: 是的，不是每个人都使用这个。

segments.en: It's a little bit of a scary instrument.
segments.zh: 这是一个有点可怕的乐器。

segments.en: It looks like it might pop your eye out.
segments.zh: 看起来它可能会突然出现你的眼睛。

segments.en: It's something you use on your eyelashes.
segments.zh: 这是你在睫毛上使用的东西。

segments.en: So those are the hairs that come off of your eye.
segments.zh: 所以那些是从你的眼睛上脱落的毛发。

segments.en: And basically, you use this to make them curly or to make them seem a bit longer and prettier.
segments.zh: 基本上，你用它来让它们卷曲或让它们看起来更长更漂亮。

segments.en: So an eyelash curler is something that, it's almost like a press or something for your eyelashes.
segments.zh: 所以睫毛夹就是它的东西，它几乎就像是一个压力器或你的睫毛的东西。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And well, now that we've got that covered, we move on to eye shadow.
segments.zh: 好吧，既然我们已经覆盖了这一点，我们继续讨论眼影。

segments.en: And I think this goes on your eyelid, right?
segments.zh: 我认为这会出现在你的眼睑上，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Some people make it go further.
segments.zh: 有些人让它走得更远。

segments.en: They put it on their face above their eyelid, but that's a little bit crazy.
segments.zh: 他们把它放在眼睑上方的脸上，但这有点疯狂。

segments.en: I think eye shadow generally goes, like you said, on your eyelid.
segments.zh: 我认为眼影通常会像你说的那样，放在你的眼睑上。

segments.en: And it can be in many different colors.
segments.zh: 它可以有许多不同的颜色。

segments.en: So blue, pink, red, whatever.
segments.zh: 所以蓝色，粉红色，红色，随便什么。

segments.en: People sometimes go crazy with eye shadow.
segments.zh: 人们有时会因眼影而发疯。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And now what about an eyebrow pencil?
segments.zh: 现在眉笔呢？

segments.en: This is basically a pencil for filling in or for coloring your eyebrows.
segments.zh: 这基本上是一支用于填充或为眉毛着色的铅笔。

segments.en: Sometimes people like to make their eyebrows look darker or thicker.
segments.zh: 有时人们喜欢让他们的眉毛看起来更黑或更厚。

segments.en: And so they use this pencil.
segments.zh: 所以他们使用这支铅笔。

segments.en: It's usually brown or black.
segments.zh: 它通常是棕色或黑色。

segments.en: And they use it on their eyebrows.
segments.zh: 他们在眉毛上使用它。

segments.en: So we've picked up a lot of vocab here related to your eye.
segments.zh: 所以我们在这里学到了很多与你的眼睛有关的词汇。

segments.en: For example, an eyelash, your eyelid.
segments.zh: 例如，睫毛，您的眼睑。

segments.en: Now we're talking about the eyebrows, which are the hairs on top, more or less around your forehead.
segments.zh: 现在我们谈论的是眉毛，它是顶部的毛发，或多或少地围绕着你的额头。

segments.en: And now we also have another type of makeup called mascara.
segments.zh: 现在我们还有另一种称为睫毛膏的化妆品。

segments.en: This is another basic.
segments.zh: 这是另一个基础。

segments.en: So like we said earlier, lipstick is something you almost always find in a woman's purse.
segments.zh: 所以就像我们之前说的，口红是你几乎总是在女人的钱包里找到的东西。

segments.en: Well, mascara is another one of those things.
segments.zh: 好吧，睫毛膏是其中的另一件事。

segments.en: Almost everybody wears mascara.
segments.zh: 几乎每个人都戴睫毛膏。

segments.en: This is kind of like a brush for your eyelashes and it paints them a different color.
segments.zh: 这有点像你睫毛的刷子，它给它们涂上了不同的颜色。

segments.en: So most women wear black or brown and it makes your eyelashes look really long.
segments.zh: 所以大多数女人都穿黑色或棕色，它让你的睫毛看起来很长。

segments.en: Oh, okay.
segments.zh: 哦，好吧。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So this is kind of like paint for your eyelashes.
segments.zh: 所以这有点像你睫毛的油漆。

segments.en: And now moving away from your eyelashes, we're going to have, we're buying also some foundation and liquid foundation.
segments.zh: 现在远离你的睫毛，我们将拥有，我们还购买了一些粉底和液体粉底。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So foundation is just a kind of base for your face.
segments.zh: 所以基础只是你脸上的一种基础。

segments.en: So foundation, like a building, is the very bottom.
segments.zh: 所以基础，就像建筑物，是最底层的。

segments.en: Well, in this case, it's something that you put on your cheeks, on your face in general, on your forehead to kind of smooth your skin out and make it look all the same color or the same texture.
segments.zh: 好吧，在这种情况下，它是你放在脸颊上、脸上、前额上的东西，以使你的皮肤变得光滑，让它看起来完全相同的颜色或相同的质地。

segments.en: And so foundation can be like we see here, either a powder, which is kind of like a dry substance, or you can use liquid foundation, which is like it says, liquid.
segments.zh: 所以粉底可以像我们在这里看到的那样，要么是一种粉末，有点像干物质，也可以使用液体粉底，就像它所说的液体。

segments.en: It's almost like a thick cream.
segments.zh: 它几乎就像厚厚的奶油。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So foundation is, as you said, I guess you just want to make your skin look the same color, the same texture, because obviously not everyone's skin is perfect.
segments.zh: 所以粉底是，正如你所说，我想你只是想让你的皮肤看起来相同的颜色，相同的质地，因为显然不是每个人的皮肤都是完美的。

segments.en: We all have some spots maybe, or some different color on our face.
segments.zh: 我们可能都有一些斑点，或者我们的脸上有一些不同的颜色。

segments.en: You say we like you wear foundation too.
segments.zh: 你说我们也喜欢你穿粉底。

segments.en: Do you wear makeup, Marco?
segments.zh: 你化妆吗，马可？

segments.en: Well, I mean, we as people because, you know.
segments.zh: 好吧，我的意思是，我们作为人，因为，你知道的。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: No, no, no, no, none of this makeup for me, although I have used an eyelash curler once.
segments.zh: 不，不，不，不，尽管我曾经使用过一次睫毛夹，但对我来说没有这些化妆品。

segments.en: That's scary.
segments.zh: 那太可怕了。

segments.en: Well, my friends dared me to, so okay.
segments.zh: 好吧，我的朋友们敢于让我这样做，所以好吧。

segments.en: And you loved it.
segments.zh: 而你喜欢它。

segments.en: Of course.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: Now I use it all the time.
segments.zh: 现在我一直在使用它。

segments.en: No, no.
segments.zh: 不，不。

segments.en: But what I do use is now things related to guys.
segments.zh: 但我现在使用的是与男人有关的东西。

segments.en: So for example, the girlfriend was saying, well, you buy razors and aftershave.
segments.zh: 例如，女朋友说，好吧，你买剃须刀和须后水。

segments.en: So what are these things?
segments.zh: 那么这些东西是什么？

segments.en: Well, razors aren't just a guy thing.
segments.zh: 好吧，剃须刀不仅仅是男人的事情。

segments.en: Everyone can have a razor.
segments.zh: 每个人都可以拥有一把剃须刀。

segments.en: It's basically a blade, like a very sharp piece of metal that you use to cut hair.
segments.zh: 它基本上是一把刀片，就像一块非常锋利的金属，你用来剪头发。

segments.en: So the hair on your legs, the hair on your face, these are things that you cut with a razor.
segments.zh: 所以你腿上的头发，脸上的头发，这些都是你用剃须刀剪的东西。

segments.en: And men use razors to shave their faces, shave their chins or above their lip.
segments.zh: 男人用剃须刀刮脸，剃掉下巴或嘴唇上方。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And well, actually, after we shave our beard, we put on a little bit of aftershave, which is basically kind of like alcohol that smells really nice.
segments.zh: 好吧，实际上，在我们刮胡子之后，我们涂了一点须后水，这基本上就像酒的味道，闻起来很香。

segments.en: That's right, because shaving can actually hurt your skin or the hairs under your skin can become really itchy or irritated.
segments.zh: 没错，因为剃须实际上会伤害您的皮肤，或者您的皮肤下的毛发会变得非常发痒或发炎。

segments.en: And so aftershave helps make everything feel better.
segments.zh: 因此，须后水有助于让一切感觉更好。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Well, and sometimes we also use a little bit of cologne to smell nice.
segments.zh: 好吧，有时我们还用一点古龙水闻起来很香。

segments.en: So women usually wear perfume, which is, you know, the perfumes like CK and Hugo Boss and all that stuff, as well as for guys, it's usually called cologne.
segments.zh: 所以女性通常会使用香水，你知道，CK 和 Hugo Boss 之类的香水以及所有这些东西，以及男性，它通常被称为古龙水。

segments.en: Okay, that's right.
segments.zh: 好吧，没错。

segments.en: It's an important difference there because we don't say perfume for guys and we don't say cologne for girls.
segments.zh: 这是一个重要的区别，因为我们不说男生香水，也不会说女孩的古龙水。

segments.en: So women wear perfume, like you said, but men wear cologne.
segments.zh: 所以女人用香水，就像你说的，但男人穿古龙水。

segments.en: And this word is very funny looking.
segments.zh: 这个词看起来很有趣。

segments.en: It ends with, it's spelled C-O-L-O-G-N-E.
segments.zh: 它以拼写为 C-O-L-O-G-N-E 结尾。

segments.en: So you don't really say the G, it's not cologna.
segments.zh: 所以你不是真的说 G，它不是科隆纳。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It's cologne.
segments.zh: 是科隆。

segments.en: And it's something that you put on your neck or your face to smell really good if you're a man.
segments.zh: 如果你是一个男人，你会戴在脖子或脸上闻起来非常好闻。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And finally, if you have long hair or maybe you have very spiky hair like I do, you need to wear a little bit of gel to kind of give your head a little bit of shape.
segments.zh: 最后，如果你有长发，或者你有像我一样有尖尖的头发，你需要戴一点凝胶来给你的头部增添一点形状。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So gel is actually the name of a kind of substance.
segments.zh: 所以凝胶实际上是一种物质的名称。

segments.en: It's not liquid, but it's not hard either.
segments.zh: 它不是液体，但也不难。

segments.en: And it's basically thick like paste that you put in your hair to keep it in one place.
segments.zh: 它基本上像糊状的糊状物，你把它放在你的头发上，把它放在一个地方。

segments.en: Yeah, it makes your hair become a little bit hard or it keeps your hairstyle in for a long time.
segments.zh: 是的，它会让你的头发变得有点硬，或者它可以长时间保持你的发型。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right, so a lot of vocab here, a lot of things that we've picked up.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这里有很多词汇，我们学到了很多东西。

segments.en: Why don't we go back, review all this great vocab on our dialogue for today.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不回去，回顾一下我们今天对话中所有这些伟大的词汇。

segments.en: I'm hungry.
segments.zh: 我饿了。

segments.en: Let's go grab a bite to eat.
segments.zh: 我们去吃点东西吧。

segments.en: Yeah, me too.
segments.zh: 对，我也是。

segments.en: Oh, can we stop at the shop really fast?
segments.zh: 哦，我们可以很快在商店停下来吗？

segments.en: I lost my makeup bag at the airport and I want to pick up a few things.
segments.zh: 我的化妆包丢在机场了，想补买几样东西。

segments.en: Will you take long?
segments.zh: 你要很久吗？

segments.en: No, five minutes.
segments.zh: 不会，就五分钟。

segments.en: I promise.
segments.zh: 我保证。

segments.en: Come on, we've been here for almost an hour.

segments.zh: 我以为你说你只会得到一些东西。

segments.zh: 首先，我的眼睛，我必须得到眼线笔、睫毛夹、眼影、眉笔和睫毛膏。

segments.en: Then I need to get foundation, liquid foundation.
segments.zh: 然后还得买粉底，液体粉底。

segments.zh: 这基本上是蜡笔。

segments.en: What about you?

segments.en: You spend as much money or more on your razors, aftershave, cologne, and gel.

segments.en: Fine, get the stupid $30 crayon.

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now we're going to take a look at three short phrases that we've picked out for you on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们要看看我们在 Flueny Builder 上为您挑选的三个短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: So this first phrase is something that we almost always say with our friends or family when we're hungry, we're shopping.
segments.zh: 所以第一个短语是我们在饥饿时几乎总是与朋友或家人说的话，我们正在购物。

segments.en: Sometimes you're outside and you just really want to eat.
segments.zh: 有时你在外面，你真的很想吃饭。

segments.en: You say, hey, let's grab a bite to eat.
segments.zh: 你说，嘿，让我们吃点东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's a very natural colloquial way of saying, let's go get something to eat or let's go eat something.
segments.zh: 这是一种非常自然的口语表达方式，我们去吃点东西或去吃点东西。

segments.en: So it could be small, it could be a snack like an ice cream, but it can also be dinner.
segments.zh: 所以它可能很小，它可以像冰淇淋一样是一种小吃，但它也可以是晚餐。

segments.en: So hey, do you want to go grab a bite to eat sometime?
segments.zh: 所以，嘿，你想找个时间去吃点东西吗？

segments.en: That means, hey, you want to go have lunch or dinner sometime?
segments.zh: 这意味着，嘿，你想找个时间去吃午餐或晚餐吗？

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So the phrase is grab a bite or go grab a bite to eat.
segments.zh: 所以这句话是咬一口或去吃点东西。

segments.en: So a bite can be a noun, like a thing, like a piece of food that you eat, but it can also be a verb, to bite, like the dog bites the man.
segments.zh: 所以咬一口可以是名词，就像你吃的一块食物，但它也可以是一个动词，咬，就像狗咬人一样。

segments.en: And so you have to be careful with this one.
segments.zh: 所以你必须小心这一种。

segments.en: In this case, it's a noun.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，它是一个名词。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And well, she wanted to first go to the store and she said, I want to pick up a few things.
segments.zh: 好吧，她想先去商店，她说，我想买一些东西。

segments.en: Well, usually when you pick something up, you take it from a table or from the ground.
segments.zh: 好吧，通常当你拿起东西时，你从桌子上或从地上拿走它。

segments.en: But in this case, it means to buy something because you can't just pick something up in a store and then walk away.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，这意味着买东西，因为你不能只是在商店里捡东西然后走开。

segments.en: You have to pay for it.
segments.zh: 你必须为此付费。

segments.en: So for example, you can say, when you come home, can you pick up a carton of milk?
segments.zh: 例如，你可以说，当你回家时，你能拿起一盒牛奶吗？

segments.en: So that means, can you buy some milk on your way home?
segments.zh: 所以这意味着，你可以在回家的路上买一些牛奶吗？

segments.en: It doesn't mean, can you take some from someone else or steal some.
segments.zh: 这并不意味着，你可以从别人那里拿一些还是偷一些。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: All right, so to pick something up, to buy, to go and get, but obviously you have to pay.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以要拿起东西，买，去拿，但显然你必须付钱。

segments.en: All right, and he used this very interesting phrase when she was getting all these things for her.
segments.zh: 好吧，当她为她准备所有这些东西时，他使用了这个非常有趣的短语。

segments.en: He said, whoa, whoa, whoa, are you nuts?
segments.zh: 他说，哇，哇，哇，你疯了吗？

segments.en: Okay, so nuts is the important word here.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以坚果是这里的重要词。

segments.en: It means crazy or out of your mind.
segments.zh: 这意味着疯狂或失去理智。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's another way of saying crazy.
segments.zh: 所以这是另一种说法。

segments.en: So if you call someone nuts or you say, he's nuts, that means.
segments.zh: 所以如果你称某人为疯子或你说，他是疯子，这意味着。

segments.en: Yeah, like don't talk to him.
segments.zh: 是的，就像不要和他说话一样。

segments.en: He's nuts.
segments.zh: 他疯了。

segments.en: Or he always says really dangerous things.
segments.zh: 或者他总是说非常危险的话。

segments.en: He's nuts.
segments.zh: 他疯了。

segments.en: So he's a little bit crazy.
segments.zh: 所以他有点疯狂。

segments.en: So it's an adjective as to describe someone that's a little bit crazy or a little bit adventurous maybe.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个形容词来形容一个有点疯狂或有点冒险的人。

segments.en: But in this case, he's not actually saying she's a crazy person.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，他实际上并不是说她是个疯子。

segments.en: He's saying, listen, this is so much stuff.
segments.zh: 他说，听着，这是很多东西。

segments.en: Are you crazy?
segments.zh: 你疯了吗？

segments.en: Or he's basically saying, do you really want to do this?
segments.zh: 或者他基本上是在说，你真的想这样做吗？

segments.en: This seems like a bad decision.
segments.zh: 这似乎是一个糟糕的决定。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So that's why he used the phrase, are you nuts?
segments.zh: 所以这就是他用这个词的原因，你疯了吗？

segments.en: Okay, so a lot of great stuff there.
segments.zh: 好吧，那里有很多很棒的东西。

segments.en: Why don't we go back, listen to our dialogue for the last time and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不回去，最后一次听我们的对话，我们会回来的。

segments.zh: 我饿了。

segments.en: Let's go grab a bite to eat.

segments.zh: 对，我也是。

segments.zh: 哦，我们可以很快在商店停下来吗？

segments.en: I lost my makeup bag at the airport and I want to pick up a few things.
segments.zh: 我的化妆包丢在机场了，想补买几样东西。

segments.en: Will you take long?
segments.zh: 你要很久吗？

segments.en: As for my eyes, I have to get eyeliner and eyelash curler, eye shadow, an eyebrow pencil and mascara.
segments.zh: 至于我的眼睛，我必须得到眼线笔和睫毛夹、眼影、眉笔和睫毛膏。

segments.en: Then I need to get foundation, liquid foundation.
segments.zh: 然后还得买粉底，液体粉底。

segments.zh: 等等，等等，等等。

segments.en: Are you nuts?
segments.zh: 你疯了吗？

segments.en: How much is all this going to cost?
segments.zh: 这一切要花多少钱？

segments.en: I'm looking at the price of each one of these little things and it's outrageous.
segments.zh: 我在看这些小东西的价格，这太离谱了。

segments.en: This is basically a crayon.
segments.zh: 这基本上是蜡笔。

segments.zh: 但你也提到了一些东西，例如掩盖。

segments.en: There's something, such makeup called cover-up.
segments.zh: 有东西，这样的妆容叫掩盖。

segments.en: Yeah, so cover-up.
segments.zh: 是的，所以掩饰。

segments.en: It could be a couple of different things in English, for example, something that you wear to cover your body when you're at the beach.
segments.zh: 它可能是一些不同的英语中的东西，例如，当你在海滩时，你穿的东西可以遮盖你的身体。

segments.en: You don't want to walk around and everyone can see you in your bathing suit.
segments.zh: 你不想四处走动，每个人都可以看到你穿着泳衣。

segments.en: But when we're talking about makeup, a cover-up is a thing that we use to hide blemishes or zits or pimples.
segments.zh: 但是当我们谈论化妆时，掩盖是我们用来隐藏瑕疵或痘痘或粉刺的东西。

segments.en: You know when you get a really small red dot on your face and you're embarrassed and it's ugly, and you don't want anyone to see it?
segments.zh: 你知道什么时候你脸上有一个非常小的红点，你很尴尬，很丑，你不想让任何人看到它？

segments.en: Well, cover-up is a kind of makeup you use that looks like your skin color and you put it on top and you can't see the red anymore.
segments.zh: 好吧，遮盖是一种你使用的化妆品，看起来像你的肤色，你把它放在上面，你再也看不到红色了。

segments.en: Okay, so you cover up your pimple.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以你掩盖你的粉刺。

segments.en: Yeah, or you use cover-up.
segments.zh: 是的，或者你使用掩饰。

segments.en: Okay, and I've also seen that, well, many girls don't really wear too much lipstick anymore nowadays.
segments.zh: 好吧，我也看到了，嗯，现在很多女孩都不会再涂太多口红了。

segments.en: They use this thing called lip gloss.
segments.zh: 他们使用这个叫做唇彩的东西。

segments.en: Okay, lip gloss.
segments.zh: 好吧，唇彩。

segments.en: Remember we were talking about polish earlier?
segments.zh: 还记得我们之前在谈论波兰语吗？

segments.en: Well, gloss is a similar word.
segments.zh: 好吧，光泽是一个相似的词。

segments.en: It means something that makes another thing shiny.
segments.zh: 它意味着使另一件事闪亮的东西。

segments.en: And so lipstick can be very dry, can be very flat, but lip gloss is something that makes things look wet, makes things look shiny.
segments.zh: 所以唇膏可以很干，可以很平，但唇彩是让东西看起来很湿的东西，让东西看起来很有光泽。

segments.en: Okay, and actually one last thing before, when we talked about gel, I guess guys use gel but women use this thing called mousse.
segments.zh: 好吧，实际上之前的最后一件事，当我们谈论凝胶时，我猜男人使用凝胶，但女人使用这种叫做摩丝的东西。

segments.en: Or they could use gel too.
segments.zh: 或者他们也可以使用凝胶。

segments.en: I don't think it's gender specific, but a lot of people use mousse.
segments.zh: 我不认为它是针对性别的，但很多人使用慕斯。

segments.zh: 像鲜奶油。

segments.en: Like whipped cream, yeah.
segments.zh: 像奶油一样，是的。

segments.en: And you put it in your hair and it's very fluffy.

segments.en: And it's actually less strong.

segments.en: But it will help shape your hair if you want to keep your hair in one place.
